intro.title: Install a Seed site on CasaOS
intro.subtitle: Add the Seed app source and install Seed Hypermedia from the App Store

beats.more-apps: Choose More apps to add a source
beats.source-url: Paste the Seed app source ZIP URL
beats.installing: CasaOS pulls the images and starts Seed
beats.installed: Seed Hypermedia is on your dashboard
beats.registration-link: Seed Web prints your registration link once — keep the secret private
beats.base-url: Set SEED_BASE_URL to your site's URL
beats.asset-host: Set SEED_ASSET_HOST to the same URL
beats.restart-policy: Set its restart policy to on-failure so it runs once
beats.restarting: Wait for Seed to come back up
beats.site: Your site is live on port 3567 — register it from Seed desktop
